headline: Executive order sets who would lead the Department of Transportation if top officials cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order sets a ranked list of officials who would act as Secretary of Transportation if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. It is meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the exact list of positions is not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily take over the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 9, 2009; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
